race.comment: MICKIDABEEL (4) looks the right horse to beat after going under by only half a length to Nothingelsematters at Mornington, and his record at around 2050m gives that near miss proper substance. Damian Lane should have a few winners by now given his book and can round out the day a winner. LARRYOCTANE (9) can run well at each way odds. He continues to run third, including over this route two back and then again at Swan Hill. He'll be running on. EPEIRIC (7) rises from a BM56 and tries around 2050m for the first time, but she is race fit, drops sharply in weight and had excuses two starts ago at Sale. PURE GRUNT (3) closed much better when fifth at Mornington and is suited coming back from that company. Consider. GINGER SWEET (11) is knocking on the door and looks a key hope.
